proof.label: Sample

reviews.name: Philippa N.
reviews.text: The proof showed the mural on a photo of our alley wall in Petworth, down to where the downspout cuts through. The finished wall matches it almost line for line. No surprises on the bill either.

reviews.name: Desmond K.
reviews.text: We got three sketches, a color strip and a square-foot price on one sheet. We sat on it for a month, came back, and the number hadn't moved.

reviews.name: Anneliese B.
reviews.text: They painted our back wall over three nights after close. Each morning there was a photo in my inbox showing how far they got against the schedule. Done on the date they wrote down in March.

reviews.name: Tobias W.
reviews.text: Our ten-year-old mural had faded to pastel on the south side. They tested swatches right on the wall, matched the original colors and resealed it.

reviews.name: Ngozi E.
reviews.text: I signed off on a marble sample board before they started the powder room. The walls look like the board. That is exactly what I wanted and almost never get from a contractor.

reviews.name: Ferdinand S.
reviews.text: Opening date was fixed, so they worked back from it: proof by the 3rd, paint by the 20th. Hit every date. People take photos in front of the shop every weekend now.

reviews.name: Marguerite H.
reviews.text: Clear quote, low-odor paint, done six weeks before our due date. The little owl over the crib is the first thing our daughter looks for in the morning.

proof.guarantee: You approve a to-scale proof before paint. If the wall doesn't match the proof, we repaint the difference.

prices.note: credited to the mural if you go ahead
